bug_semantics: The public reproducer invokes tcpreplay with `-p -0.000001`. `tcpreplay_post_args` parses that nonzero string with `atof`, so the later `if (!n)` guard does not reject it, then scales it by 3600 and casts -0.0036 to the integer `COUNTER`, producing a zero packets-per-hour value. The packet-rate branch of `calc_sleep_time` subsequently divides its next-transmit-time numerator by that zero `pph`, raising SIGFPE and terminating the local replay process.
flaw_origin: Single PR-member commit fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9 changed `--pps` from AutoOpts `arg-type = number` to an unrestricted string, parsed it with `atof`, stored `(COUNTER)(n * 60 * 60)` without validating sign/range or the post-conversion integer, and changed `calc_sleep_time` to divide by the resulting packets-per-hour value. Its immediate parent could not take the advisory's fractional string through this conversion path. The member was squash-landed as 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251; a 2021 exact-zero check in ebed7dde22ef3b77ceb64eefa2c873b92b435dda did not repair negative or positive nonzero fractions whose scaled integer is zero.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer `Fred Klassen <fklassen@appneta.com>`, contains a GPG signature and the message `#270 allow fractions for --pps`, and has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool, or bot marker.
evidence: First-party report https://github.com/appneta/tcpreplay/issues/968 and its attached reproduction screenshot show `/tcpreplay -p -0.000001 -i lo ...` at snapshot 6fcbf0324088561d95c356fe8337f4faac275f1a, followed by AddressSanitizer SIGFPE at `src/send_packets.c:1125` in `calc_sleep_time`; maintainer Fred Klassen later wrote that the crash reproduced at 6fcbf03.

PR https://github.com/appneta/tcpreplay/pull/287 exposes one member commit, fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9. `git cat-file -p` resolves its sole parent as d689d14dbcd768c028eab2fb378d849e543dcfe9, author/committer as Fred Klassen, and no AI trailer. The validated clone retains this otherwise-unreachable member object.

`git rev-parse fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9^{tree} 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251^{tree}` returns the same tree 2de74ea3854acfdd290df0f6a7e62e9deffc24c0 for both; `git diff --quiet` returns 0, and both commits have parent d689d14dbcd768c028eab2fb378d849e543dcfe9. Thus 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251 is the squash landing of the one smaller, reconstructable PR member rather than the BIC used for attribution.

Direct parent-tree comparison (`git diff d689d14dbcd768c028eab2fb378d849e543dcfe9 fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9 -- src/tcpreplay_opts.def src/tcpreplay_api.c src/send_packets.c`) proves absence: the parent defines `--pps` as numeric and assigns `OPT_VALUE_PPS`; the BIC changes it to string, adds `atof` plus integer packets-per-hour conversion, and introduces the corresponding `/ pph` calculation. Those coupled vulnerable lines are absent from the immediate parent.

Lineage checks show the later line blamed at the advisory stack location is not a smaller origin: `git blame` attributes the parser conversion to the 2017 change and the current nanosecond-form division to later formatting/timing work, while the BIC already contains the same zero-pph division mechanism in microseconds. Commit ebed7dde22ef3b77ceb64eefa2c873b92b435dda only adds `if (!n)`, which -0.000001 bypasses.

Version membership is established through the landed identical tree: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251 v4.2.0` and the same check against v4.5.1 both return 0. v4.2.0 resolves to 01dfc152aa5a728813db56c7b9750087c681f839; v4.5.1 resolves to 0ba7d17fcb9ddedf61168f99c249b30731310d4e; the reported 6fcbf0324088561d95c356fe8337f4faac275f1a describes as `v4.5.1-1-g6fcbf032` and has the v4.5.1 release commit as a parent.

No patched boundary is present in the validated full history. The advisory is unreviewed and lists affected/patched versions as unknown while recommending `4.5.3-beta3`; `git tag --list '*4.5*'` shows no v4.5.3-beta3 tag. v4.5.2 resolves to 98169912173986cc48a4ad325997dcc20c38af28 and preserves the vulnerable parser and division (the 6fcbf03..v4.5.2 diff changes only copyright in those two files). At validated HEAD c3f6049a1de91e7d3b81543d0ecb01e465b05214, `tcpreplay_api.c` still accepts any nonzero `atof` result and casts it after scaling, while `send_packets.c` still divides by the resulting `pph`. History searches for issue 968, CVE-2025-9649, division-by-zero, and invalid-PPS remediation find no complete fix, justifying null fix SHAs.
reasoning: The vulnerability is not rooted in the 2024 merge snapshot named by the reporter or in the later line-formatting commit seen by blame. History reconstruction reaches the 2017 fractional-PPS feature. PR #287 had one original commit, fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9, and GitHub squash-landed an identical tree as 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251. The original member is therefore the smallest real BIC. Its immediate parent lacks the advisory-specific string-to-floating-to-integer packets-per-hour path and its coupled division, satisfying direct parent absence. The identical landed tree is present by v4.2.0 and in the reported v4.5.1 lineage. The 2021 zero check only rejects an exact floating zero; the PoC's -0.000001 remains nonzero until scaling/casting collapses it to integer zero. Contrary to the advisory's recommended but nonexistent v4.5.3-beta3 boundary, the same causal code persists through v4.5.2 and validated HEAD, so the case is genuinely unpatched and both fix fields are null. Finally, only the original BIC commit object was used for attribution: it is a human-authored, human-committed, GPG-signed Fred Klassen commit with no AI marker, yielding NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: Unpatched: no complete remediation commit or valid patched version boundary exists in the validated history through c3f6049a1de91e7d3b81543d0ecb01e465b05214. The advisory's `4.5.3-beta3` recommendation is not backed by a repository tag, and the vulnerable conversion/division remains in later tags and HEAD.
